announcements.title: Baptisms
announcements.body: Praise God — we have a baptism service coming up, with several people preparing to be baptized. More details as the date approaches.

announcements.title: Women's Ministry Crocktoberfest
announcements.body: Ladies, fall is here and Crocktoberfest is back — fellowship, delicious food, a fun seasonal craft, and a great night to invite friends. Sign-ups are on Basecamp. If you've been part of our church family for less than six months, please don't feel any pressure to bring anything; we're simply glad to have you.

announcements.title: New Member Class
announcements.body: Saturday, October 17 and Sunday, October 18. Sign up on Basecamp.

announcements.title: Men's Retreat
announcements.body: Men, mark your calendars for our annual Men's Retreat. Meet Justin Lackmacher, founder of Redemption House. Chris and Dov have gotten to know Justin over the years and are absolutely thrilled to have him spend time with the men at Providence. Justin is a former addict, a current minister to addicts, and — as Pastor Chris puts it — has serious Biblical Counseling game. Spots are limited; registration cost increases on October 12.
